nodes.name: Convert it
nodes.notes: MarkItDown runs in bi-brain-web. neverError so a refusal comes back as data instead of stopping the workflow.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO kb (source, chunk_index, content, embedding)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2::int,
  $3,
  -- The embedding arrives as a JSON array of numbers and is cast here. Passing
  -- it as a JSON string rather than a raw array keeps it a bound parameter.
  (SELECT array_agg(x::float8) FROM json_array_elements_text($4::json) AS x)
)
ON CONFLICT (source, chunk_index) DO UPDATE
  SET content    = EXCLUDED.content,
      embedding  = EXCLUDED.embedding,
      created_at = now();

nodes.name: Sweep the old tail
nodes.notes: Removes chunks left over from a longer previous version of the same document. Without it, deleted paragraphs stay answerable.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, source: $('One item for the sweep').first().json.source, chunks: $('One item for the sweep').first().json.chunks, chars: $('Ready to chunk').first().json.chars, warn: $('Ready to chunk').first().json.warn }) }}

nodes.name: Respond (nothing to read)
nodes.notes: A scan has no text in it. That is a correct answer, not an error - the dashboard shows it grey, the way the ask box shows a refusal.
